_comment: Catalog of mesh command types (proprietary range 128-255): the meaning of each type for display/labelling. The authoritative set a given relay can run comes from the relay itself (its [commands.commands]); use 'discover' to query it. 'params' describe an optional command payload (reserved for future parameterised commands).

commands.name: reboot
commands.description: Reboot the relay (re-opens the boot-time WiFi access window).

commands.name: restart-stack
commands.description: Soft-restart the mesh stack (concentratord + gateway-relay) without a full reboot.

commands.name: set-hop-count
commands.description: Set the mesh max hop count (1-8) and persist it.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Compact health snapshot: uptime, load, temperature, memory, SenOS version.

commands.name: power
commands.description: Charge-controller telemetry: battery, solar, state-of-charge, load (off-grid essentials).

commands.name: version
commands.description: Report the SenOS image version (fleet / upgrade tracking).

commands.name: ping
commands.description: Connectivity check: the relay replies 'pong' (the ack proves mesh reachability).

commands.name: list-commands
commands.description: Report the command types this relay has configured (mesh discovery).
